messages:
Liam (CS): Quick heads up, MarigoldHealth renewal coming up — target sign date 2026-05-02. Procurement submitted PO but vendor_code doesn't match our payables. Also they requested 6-month term and net30. Need to confirm tax entity before we send DocuSign.

Sofia (AM): Thanks Liam. Can someone flag who owns vendor code fixes? @Eve? Also confirm whether Sales ok with 6mo pricing change.

Eve (Billing): I can take vendor code. PO has `vendor_code: 7765` but our ERP shows `6675`. Looks like digits swapped. If they go to 6mo instead of 12 we need to apply the short-term uplift we use for sub-annual terms (5% on term price). Seat counts?

Rita (Customer): Confirm seats = 20 active today. We might add 4 more in July. Finance says they can move to net30 for payment. They can reissue PO if needed.

Liam (CS): Noted. Primary blockers: vendor_code mismatch and missing VAT/tax id on EMEA PO. Carlos, do we have a quick amendment template for entity swap + 6mo?

Carlos (Legal): Yep, I have a 6-month amendment template that includes billing entity swap language and delegated signer routing. I'll draft and include a clause for vendor code confirmation. Quick checklist I'll use: (1) require reissued PO with correct vendor_code; (2) attach updated billing entity name + VAT/Tax ID; (3) short-term amendment (6mo) with net30; (4) DocuSign routing to delegated finance approver.

OnboardingBot: Action logged: MarigoldHealth -> renewal status set to "awaiting corrected PO". Reminder in 48h.

Eve (Billing): Once we receive corrected PO with vendor_code `6675` and VAT ID, Billing will accept. If they add +4 seats, we will prorate for remaining months; formula: prorate = monthly_rate * (remaining_months / 12) * seats_added. I can prepare a sample prorate calc for transparency.

Sofia (AM): I'll ask Marigold finance to reissue PO today and include VAT. I'll also confirm whether Sales approves the 5% short-term uplift.

Rita (Customer): I'll ask Finance to reissue PO with vendor_code=6675 and include VAT ID: pending (they'll confirm). We prefer to sign ASAP.

Liam (CS): Action items: Sofia to request reissued PO by EOD; Carlos to post draft amendment to DocSend; Eve to prepare invoice-routing notes and sample prorate; I'll schedule a 45min enablement for new seats once signed.

Sofia (AM): Draft amendment posted: https://docsend.com/marigold-6mo-amend-9876 — includes vendor code and billing entity fields. Please review and flag any legal/billing concerns before I send to customer.

Carlos (Legal): Reviewed and minor tweak done re: delegated signer. Updated link: https://docsend.com/marigold-6mo-amend-9876-v2. Good to send once PO corrected.

Eve (Billing): Reviewed; finance awaits PO + VAT ID. I'll queue invoice routing on signed amendment and confirm GL code mapping after PO accepted.

Liam (CS): Running quick checklist here:
```
- Request reissued PO with vendor_code=6675 and VAT/Tax ID
- Apply 6mo amendment (include 5% uplift) -> DocuSign
- Confirm billing entity: MarigoldHealth EMEA (Tax ID required)
- Pro-rate +4 seats if added (prepare sample calc)
- Schedule enablement (45m) post-sign
- Update Salesforce: renewal status -> signed when complete
```

Sofia (AM): Marking thread blocked -> waiting on corrected PO. Setting 48h follow-up. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Rita (Customer): Thanks team — I'll push Finance to reissue and get back by EOD.

Liam (CS): Thanks everyone. Will keep tracker updated and book enablement once DocuSign completes. :thumbsup:
